title: Handover scenario tests with example rows and requests
description: scenarios.json /3 in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/): /2 (docs/handover-scenarios-2.schema.json, unchanged) plus an optional `request` on each `api` example (C4b). Written instead of /2 only when a bound structured test scenario with example rows has examples carrying `request`; otherwise the file is /2 or /1, byte for byte. `request` is {path, query, body?}: `path` maps each path parameter of `operation.path` to its value, `query` maps query parameter names to values (both JSON scalars: string, number or boolean, as written; the consumer converts), and `body` is the JSON request body (the scenario's effect.body with the example's placeholder values, or the example's own request.body when there is no effect.body); `body` is absent when the call has none. designc refuses at mint and at freeze a request that lacks a required parameter, names an unknown one, or gives a body the operation does not take or lacks. MATCHING SEMANTICS (the contract the Factory's generated API tests follow; X4 slice 7 pins this schema): seed the `given` rows, call `operation` with `request.path` substituted into the path, `request.query` as the query string and `request.body` as the JSON body (no body when absent), then query. An api example WITHOUT `request` is not callable: consumers skip it. A `then` row WITH `id`: the stored row of that entity with that id exists, and each listed field deep-equals the expected value. A `then` row WITHOUT `id`: at least one stored row of that entity deep-equals the expected value on every listed field. Fields and rows that are not listed are not checked; absence is not asserted. Rows are literal JSON values, in file order, verbatim; keys of `given` and `then` are qualified entity ids `pack/Aggregate`; `entities` lists only the aggregates the rows use. The scenario files themselves are named by path and sha256, not copied. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-scenarios-3.example.json is the shared fixture.

screens.description: One entry per render screen with at least one compiled scenario, ordered by screen. A scenario of an overlay (hosted) spec is on the host's entry.

component.description: The page component the test imports and renders (the spec's `component`).

path.description: Registry path of the scenario file.

operation.description: The request the test waits for, resolved from contracts/openapi at freeze; path is the OpenAPI path as written. The test mocks it with `{p}` as `:p`, after the path part of the file's servers[0].url if it has one.

index.description: 1-based; the n in the test title.

skipped.description: Structured scenarios of a requirement in the handover that were not compiled, with the reason. Never dropped silently. Ordered by scenario id.

operation.description: The request the test waits for, resolved from contracts/openapi at freeze; path is the OpenAPI path as written. The test mocks it with `{p}` as `:p`, after the path part of the file's servers[0].url if it has one.

given.description: Seed rows: qualified entity id -> rows. {} when absent.

then.description: Expected rows after the call: qualified entity id -> rows (see MATCHING SEMANTICS).

request.description: The call inputs (C4b). Optional: an example without it is not callable.

body.description: The JSON request body; absent when the call has none.

entities.description: The aggregates the rows use, ordered by id.

fields.description: The aggregate's declared fields (the identity `id` is implicit), as read from the pack: name plus type, ref or oneOf.
